name: Business expense reimbursement (因公支出)
authority: 所得稅法 §14(1)(3) (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=G0340003&flno=14): travel and per-diem expenses paid for the employer’s purpose within the prescribed standard are not salary income — an actual-cost reimbursement with its receipt counts toward no tax, insurance or pension base.
